title: The Nanny Nobody Wanted
style: cinematic live-action film still, 35mm, shallow depth of field, rich warm golden grade, realistic skin, vertical 9:16

elena.look: Elena, a gentle woman in her late 20s with long wavy dark hair, kind brown eyes, simple cream cardigan

dante.look: Dante Moretti, a tall serious man in his late 30s in a black tailored suit, short black hair, sharp jawline, cold eyes

twins.look: two 6-year-old twins, a boy and a girl, dark hair, in matching navy school uniforms, sad faces

scenes.image: [[elena]] standing nervously at the gates of a huge marble mansion in the rain, holding a small suitcase
scenes.motion: slow crane up over the gates, rain falling
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Seven nannies had quit this house. Elena was the eighth.

scenes.image: [[dante]] in a dark study looking down coldly at [[elena]], a fire burning behind him
scenes.speaker: dante
scenes.line: My children do not smile anymore. Do not expect them to start.

scenes.image: [[twins]] hiding on the staircase, watching [[elena]] with suspicious eyes
scenes.speaker: twins
scenes.line: She will leave too. They all leave.

scenes.image: [[elena]] kneeling in front of the twins, offering a small paper boat, gentle smile
scenes.speaker: elena
scenes.line: I am not here to replace anyone. I am here to stay.

scenes.image: Close-up of the twins' hands touching the paper boat, a tiny smile appearing, warm light
scenes.motion: slow push-in on hands, soft focus
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: For the first time in two years, laughter echoed through the mansion.

scenes.image: [[dante]] watching from the doorway in the shadows, his cold expression softening slightly
scenes.motion: slow rack focus onto his face
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: And the most feared man in the city could not look away.

scenes.image: Night, [[elena]] finds a framed photo in a drawer of a woman who looks exactly like her, hand over her mouth, shocked
scenes.motion: slow zoom into her stunned face, thunder flash
scenes.speaker: elena
scenes.line: Why... does she have my face?

scenes.image: [[dante]] standing behind [[elena]] in the dark hallway, hand on the doorframe, intense stare
scenes.motion: he steps out of shadow, camera pushes in
scenes.speaker: dante
scenes.line: I hoped you would never find that. Part two... tomorrow.

caption: She came to care for his children. She found his secret. #drama #romance #story
next_hook: Why does the photo woman look exactly like Elena?
